messages:
Mia Chen: Hey team, quick help — can't access GCP project 'rw-prod-eu' and AWS account for sandbox. Cloud access doc says ask here. I get 403 on gcloud, and aws sso returns 'NoPermission'. Need me to run any commands?
cloud-onboard-bot: Welcome Mia! Please fill out the cloud-access form: https://redwood.example.com/onboard-cloud. You'll need org SSO group assignment. If urgent, ping @Priya or @Sam.
Priya: Hey Mia — welcome! I can check GCP roles. Can you paste output of: ```gcloud projects get-iam-policy rw-prod-eu --format=json``` (or just the error text) and for AWS, which account id shows in the error?
Mia Chen: GCP error is: Permission 'resourcemanager.projects.get' denied on project rw-prod-eu (or resource). AWS SSO shows: 'You don't have permission to assume role: rw-sandbox-admin'. Account id 123456789012.
Sam: That's likely missing the group mapping. @Priya we usually add 'eng-new-hires' to roles/viewer and the 'eng-aws-sso' mapping. I'll queue it but need the form + manager approval. Mia can you confirm manager is Maya Lopez?
Mia Chen: Yep manager is Maya Lopez. Submitted cloud-access form ~5m ago, status says pending.
Ops Dev: I see a pending ticket INC-1123 from the form. Priya, can you approve? In the meantime, Mia, as a workaround use the staging project 'rw-staging-eu' — you should have viewer there. For quick AWS check, run `aws sso login` then `aws sts get-caller-identity` to confirm.
Priya: Approving now. Also granting temporary role 'roles/viewer' on rw-prod-eu to Mia Chen for 1 hour while we confirm manager approval. Will post when done.
cloud-onboard-bot: Access change logged: rw-prod-eu +roles/viewer -> granted to Mia Chen (expires in 60m) by Priya. Ticket INC-1123 updated.
Mia Chen: Got it — gcloud now returns project metadata, thanks! aws sso still blocked though. Sam, thanks for queueing — shout if you need anything from me.
Sam: Pushed AWS mapping, should propagate in ~10min. If still blocked try clearing SSO cache: `rm -rf ~/.aws/sso/cache` then `aws sso login`. Ping here if not fixed.
Mia Chen: AWS works now. Thanks everyone :tada:
